content.text: {"Id":"BUG-TRIAGE-126","Title":"PowerShell.Mcp console rollover drops MCP workspace env","Section":"Backlog","Priority":"high","Done":false,"Estimate":null,"Note":null,"Description":["When user-prompt-submit is routed to a newly allocated PowerShell.Mcp console because existing consoles are busy, the new process starts at the user profile (for example C:\\Users\\kingd) without MCP_WORKSPACE_PATH or MCP_CACHE_DIR_OVERRIDE. Plugin cache resolution (resolve-cache-dir.ps1) then cannot locate a marker or configured workspace and throws, so the mandatory hook fails before Open-PluginTurn. Internal plugin child launches (Invoke-McpPlugin.ps1) do re-inject workspace env, but that path does not cover third-party PowerShell.Mcp multi-console allocation. Reapplying documented workspace env and cwd restores the turn. Origin workspace in report: F:\\GitHub\\TruckMate.","Triage group: triage-group-dac5aa8b6d538b43","Reports: 1"],"TechnicalDetails":["Acceptance criteria:","- When PowerShell.Mcp allocates a new console under load (existing consoles busy), the new console process has MCP_WORKSPACE_PATH set to the active workspace (or an equivalent explicit workspace handoff) before any MCP plugin hook runs.","- When a new console is allocated, MCP_CACHE_DIR_OVERRIDE is either preserved from the active session or left unset only if MCP_WORKSPACE_PATH (or marker discovery from workspace cwd) is sufficient for Resolve-McpCacheDir.","- The new console WorkingDirectory is the active workspace path, not the user profile, unless an explicit override is supplied.","- user-prompt-submit against a newly allocated console opens the turn successfully without manual reapplication of environment variables.","- A regression test or documented runner contract proves that console rollover preserves workspace context (env and/or explicit -WorkspacePath) for mandatory hooks.","Implementation notes:","- Likely seam is the PowerShell.Mcp (PSGallery) console pool / runner used by agents, not the in-repo Invoke-McpPlugin ProcessStartInfo path which already sets MCP_WORKSPACE_PATH, MCPSERVER_WORKSPACE_PATH, MCP_WORKSPACE_START_DIR, and optional MCP_CACHE_DIR_OVERRIDE for its own child pwsh.","- Fail path is Resolve-McpCacheDir in plugins/core/lib-ps/resolve-cache-dir.ps1: with cwd under the user profile and no MCP_WORKSPACE_PATH / MCP_CACHE_DIR_OVERRIDE, marker walk fails and it throws Unable to resolve the active workspace cache.","- Preferred fix: ensure every PowerShell.Mcp-allocated console inherits or is initialized with workspace env and cwd from the active agent workspace; secondary defense: hook/wrapper entrypoints re-assert workspace from host params when env is missing on rollover.","- Update PowerShell.Mcp Command Routing guidance in templates/prompt-templates.yaml (and graphrag mirror) to require workspace env \u002B cwd on every new console, not only the first session, similar to BUG-TRIAGE-084 cross-volume TEMP guidance.","- Do not treat this as a TruckMate-specific defect; workspacePath for triage is F:\\GitHub\\McpServer (plugin/runtime owner)."],"ImplementationTasks":null,"CompletedDate":null,"DoneSummary":null,"Remaining":null,"PriorityNote":null,"Reference":null,"Phase":null,"DependsOn":null,"FunctionalRequirements":["FR-MCP-TRIAGE-002"],"TechnicalRequirements":["TR-MCP-TRIAGE-004"],"IdempotencyKey":null}
